auditScope.effectiveRule: Current publication overrides latest immutable source; no drafts read or changed.

publicationProcedure.authority: Normal Master Commit with freshly read revision and catalogue token after immutable source registration. Preserve existing drafts and history; never execute these stale metadata values as a mutation payload.
publicationProcedure.versionRule: max(existing publication versions, record.versionFloor, builtin source versionFloor) + 1
publicationProcedure.predictionCondition: Only if no intervening authoring or publication change; refresh and review first.
